name: mochart-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the mochart charting library, the movalid validation library, and the mochart demo app

scripts.preview:pages: PAGES_BASE=/ node scripts/build-pages.mjs && PAGES_BASE=/ node scripts/preview-pages.mjs
scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @mochart/movalid && npm run build -w @mochart/core && npm run build -w @mochart/editor && npm run build -w @mochart/export && npm run build -w @mochart/react && npm run build -w @mochart/svelte && npm run build -w @mochart/vue && npm run build -w @mochart/lit && npm run build -w @mochart/angular
scripts.publish:libs: npm run check:publish && pnpm -C packages/movalid publish && pnpm -C packages/mochart publish && pnpm -C packages/mochart-editor publish && pnpm -C packages/mochart-export publish && pnpm -C packages/mochart-react publish && pnpm -C packages/mochart-svelte publish && pnpm -C packages/mochart-vue publish && pnpm -C packages/mochart-lit publish && pnpm -C packages/mochart-angular publish
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @mochart/demo-basic && npm run test:e2e -w @mochart/demo-vanilla
